prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1471; do not mention it.)
text:
We represent the injured party in connection with the sideswipe collision that occurred while our client was changing lanes. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative has already made contact with our client, please let us know so that we may address it.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy under which your insured is covered, along with a copy of the declarations page. We also ask that you confirm in writing whether coverage is being accepted or disputed.

Please preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle data and telematics, dash camera footage, repair estimates, adjuster notes, and any communications with the other driver or witnesses. Any loss or alteration of this material could expose your company to sanctions in any later proceeding.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
